name: Vauren Inspired by YSL Tuxedo | Spicy Amber Luxury Men’s Perfume
description: Vauren, inspired by the iconic YSL Tuxedo, is a bold, spicy-amber men’s fragrance crafted for confident individuals who appreciate refined elegance. The scent opens with a sharp blend of bergamot and black pepper, offering a fresh yet spicy introduction. As it unfolds, smooth patchouli, floral nuances, and warm spices create a sophisticated heart that feels modern and luxurious. The base features ambergris, vanilla, and deep woody notes, delivering a sensual, long-lasting finish that leaves a powerful impression. With its high perfume-oil concentration, Vauren offers excellent longevity and projection—making it ideal for evenings, formal events, dinners, and winter seasons. Stylish, seductive, and unforgettable, Vauren perfectly captures the essence of YSL Tuxedo at an accessible price—exclusive to Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Bergamot, Black Pepper Heart Notes: Patchouli, Spices, Floral Accords Base Notes: Ambergris, Vanilla, Woody Notes Longevity: 8–10 hours (Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for evenings, formal events, and winters Why Choose Vauren? story: Vauren, inspired by YSL Tuxedo, opens with bergamot and black pepper, evolves into patchouli and spices, and finishes with ambergris and woods—creating a bold, elegant men’s fragrance.
